description: Lists the signed-in coach's AI workout and program generations for the team, or one in detail. Use when the user asks what the AI made recently, which guideline it followed, or whether a draft was saved. Not for video jobs (use list_video_jobs). Returns name, kind, status, date and the saved item's ID; with generation_id, also the guideline and rule results.

generation_id.description: One generation to open in detail, from an earlier list_generations call. Omit to list.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_generations
title: List AI generation history
